description: This file defines the DurableValue class implementing a durable, serializable, generic value with state machine capabilities, including methods for applying log entries, snapshotting, and managing persistence state within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: DurableValue<T>
classes.description: A generic class implementing durable, serializable state machine value with versioning, change tracking, and log application capabilities within Orleans.

methods.name: DurableValue
methods.description: Constructor initializing the durable value with dependencies and registering the state machine.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Property getter and setter for the stored value, with change tracking.

methods.name: OnModified
methods.description: Marks the value as dirty when modified.

methods.name: OnValuePersisted
methods.description: Invokes the OnPersisted callback when the value is persisted.

methods.name: OnRecoveryCompleted
methods.description: Handles recovery completion event, triggering persistence callback.

methods.name: OnWriteCompleted
methods.description: Handles write completion event, triggering persistence callback.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the state machine with new storage.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to update the value, supporting versioning and command types.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Appends log entries if the state is dirty.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Appends a snapshot of the current state.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the durable value (not implemented).

methods.name: WriteState
methods.description: Serializes the current state into a writer.

methods.name: ThrowIndexOutOfRange
methods.description: Throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException for invalid index access.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Returns the current storage writer, asserting it is not null.
